Equipment
 Pressure Filter, Return Filter, Tank, Fluid & 
 Cooler

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Galal Essawy, revised by eng. tested by eng. Mostafa 
 Mohamed El Nahal, tested by eng. Khaled Ahmad El-Sayed, accepted by
 general manager eng. Ahmed Abd El Rahman 
 Ali, revised by eng. 
 Nasser Bahgat MPIS coordinator, approved by eng. Mahmoud El 
 Naquib head sector of Ayon Mousa PS. 
 and certified by eng. Solman Zaki Soliman general manager of inspection 
 and quality insurance.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 delivery and suction valves.
Empty oil tank when cleaning it.

Manual Puller, Feeler Gauge, Rags, 
 Cleaning Fluid.

Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).

Clean oil by Alfa Laval and adjust 
 oil level of pump.

Check bolts fixation, then 
 retightens it (if it is needed).

Check the validity of oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed).

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 delivery and suction valves.
Empty oil tank when cleaning it.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Main Crane, Alfa Laval.
Manual Puller, Feeler Gauge, Rags, 
 Cleaning Fluid.
Dial Indicator, Vibrometer.
Steel tank valid to 400 liter
Work to be 
carried out
Equipment in Service
Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).
Equipment out of Service
Clean oil by Alfa Laval and adjust 
 oil level of pump.
Check bolts fixation, then 
 retightens it (if it is needed).
Check the validity of oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed).
Check flanges for leakage.
Clean the oil tank.
